prompt: Build a 5-qubit circuit implementing, as a general-purpose circuit block: Hadamard on all 5 qubits, then the phase exp(-i*gamma*H) where H = 0.5 * Z0 * Z1 * Z2 * Z3 * Z4 (a single five-body interaction term over all 5 qubits, in index order). gamma = 0.5. This circuit will be transpiled for a 5-qubit LINEAR coupling map (qubit i only physically adjacent to qubit i-1 and i+1) — the qubits are listed in adjacent order, so a low-overhead implementation exists. Any correct implementation is accepted (the term is diagonal, so any gate sequence producing the correct phase per computational basis state is correct — it does not need to match one specific decomposition). No measurement.
